title: He Broke His Master's Bowl. Then This Happened ✨ | A Japanese Fable
tiktok_title: He shattered his master's favourite bowl. The master's answer?
caption:
He shattered his master's favourite bowl… so why did the old potter keep every piece? ✨ A tale of kintsugi: mending what's broken with gold.

#talesinink #moralstories #fable #ukiyoe #shorts #kintsugi #healing #storytime
moral: Your cracks are not your end. Mend them in gold.
